paragraphs.source_en: Weary, Nene placed a pillow on her knees and pressed her forehead against it. She wished to sleep but could not; she wished to remain awake, yet only grew more exhausted. Listening closely, she heard the autumn wind blowing desolately past the eaves. That wind would turn bitterly cold and scatter every leaf through the streets and alleys… Tsurumatsu’s death was an omen that autumn had come to the Toyotomi house.
